description:
Yvonne lives a quiet life running her small clothing shop, content in her routine—until the night a dangerously handsome man named Jerome steps through her door.

Captivated by his dark charm, Yvonne is swept into a passionate affair. But Jerome only appears under the cover of night, leaving behind a trail of whispers and unanswered questions.

As his true identity unravels, Yvonne finds herself torn between the harrowing truth and the irresistible compulsion to surrender.

“So don’t run away... Feel it properly.”

She knows he is a secret she shouldn't keep, yet every night, she waits for the sound of the door opening.
